texts.detail.hero: 宋韵象牙白，一杯清茶｜德化高白瓷三才盖碗，素雅温润。150ml黄金容量，单手轻持95g，为现代茶席添一抹东方雅意。
texts.detail.selling_points: 匠心白瓷，轻若无物｜德化高白瓷胎体洁净透光；1280-1350℃一次烧成抗热冲击；整器仅95g，久持不坠手。
texts.detail.material_craft: 千年瓷都，纯净如骨｜取自德化高岭土，经高温窑火一次烧成。象牙白釉面致密，素面造型克制百搭。
texts.detail.size_capacity: 黄金尺寸，一人茶量｜碗高54mm、口径94mm、足径40mm，150ml容量符合一人份功夫茶习惯，出汤从容。
texts.detail.scenes: 日常茶席，从容自饮｜适合一人独处功夫茶、办公迷你下午茶或朋友到访互敬，百搭现代与中式茶席。
texts.detail.details: 细节考究，触手温润｜口沿平滑圆润，足底露胎自然，盖钮握持舒适。素面设计无多余装饰，尽显匠心。
texts.detail.packaging: 严选防护，安心送达｜易碎品专项包装，内衬防震。适配京东德化产地仓物流方案，降低运输破损风险。
texts.detail.care: 现代友好，省心清洁｜釉面致密无金属彩，支持微波炉加热与洗碗机清洗。日常使用后建议竖放晾干，避免串味。
texts.detail.service: 概念展示，敬请期待｜本页部分图片为AI效果图，以量产实物为准。支持京东商家服务中心选品，期待您见证。
texts.amazon.title: White Porcelain Gaiwan Teaware Set, 5.1 fl oz (150 ml), Three-Piece Lidded Cup with Lid and Saucer, Light Ivory Color, Dishwasher Safe, Minimalist Design for Gaiwan Tea Ceremony
texts.amazon.bullets[0]: PORCELAIN CRAFT: Made from premium ivory white porcelain, single-fired at high temperatures for a durable, smooth surface suitable for daily tea use.
texts.amazon.bullets[1]: LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN: The entire set weighs only 95 g, offering a comfortable and effortless grip for extended tea sessions without hand fatigue.
texts.amazon.bullets[2]: EASY TO CLEAN: The three-piece structure allows for convenient handling and is both dishwasher and microwave safe, fitting modern home routines.
texts.amazon.bullets[3]: MODERN AESTHETIC: Features a plain, decorative-free finish in a classic lidded bowl shape that complements minimalist, Japanese, or Chinese interiors.
texts.amazon.bullets[4]: PERFECT GIFT: A refined and practical tea accessory, ideal for gifting to tea lovers, newlyweds, or colleagues for special occasions.
